_comment: Canonical item registry for the TNDK/DCTS refrigeration spares price book.
One key per physical thing we buy. Vendors describe the same part five ways;
this file is what lets two quotations be compared line to line.
Add a key only when a real quotation contains the item. Never invent a part.
'compare_note' is a warning that two vendors' lines under this key are NOT
strictly like for like - the comparison script prints it next to the price.

condensing-unit-dorin-au-h300cc.description: Dorin condensing unit, Aeris anti-corrosive coating

expansion-valve-te2.description: Thermostatic expansion valve TE2 / TES-2, R404A/R507A

sight-glass-sgi12s.compare_note: Material list specifies SOLDER type; Arctic line does not state connection type. Confirm before treating as identical.

ball-valve-half.compare_note: Different brands: Danfoss GBC 12S (009L7022) vs Castel 6570/4. Function-equivalent, not identical.

pressure-switch-kp15.description: Dual pressure switch KP15, auto reset
pressure-switch-kp15.compare_note: Material list bundles a flexible hose with the switch; Arctic quotes the switch alone and the hose separately. Compare the bundle, not the headline.

flare-nut-half.compare_note: Brands differ (Olab vs RW). Commodity fitting.

flare-nut-three-eighths.compare_note: Brands differ (Castel 7010/33 vs RW). Commodity fitting.

flexible-connector-1mtr.description: Flexible connector / charging hose with 1/4" nut, approx 1 m
flexible-connector-1mtr.compare_note: Material list calls it FLEXIBLE HOSE RED/BLUE; Arctic calls it FLEXIBLE CONNECTOR WITH 1/4 NUT -1MTR. Quantities differ between the two documents (2 vs 3).

solenoid-valve-1068-4a6.compare_note: Material list price is stated to INCLUDE the coil. Arctic line does not say whether the coil is included - confirm. A coil is a separately priced part, so this is the most material open question in the comparison.

copper-coil-half-50ft.description: Copper coil / pipe 1/2" x 50 ft roll

copper-coil-seven-eighths-50ft.description: Copper coil / pipe 7/8" x 50 ft roll

pipe-insulation-seven-eighths.compare_note: NOT like for like. Material list = 1.8 m length (70 pcs/box). Arctic line states no length. A 4x unit-price gap is expected if the Arctic piece is shorter - resolve the length before using either rate.

capillary-tube.compare_note: NOT like for like. Material list = 0.9 m cut length WITH 1/4" straight nut fitted (an assembly). Arctic = bulk tube priced per metre off a 100 ft coil. Do not compare the unit figures directly.

charging-union-quarter-npt.description: Charging union / NPT connector, 1/4" flare x 1/8" NPT
charging-union-quarter-npt.compare_note: Material list = Castel 7140/21. Arctic quotes both a Castel 9150/R02 connector (10.00) and a charging union w/pin (8.00); the union is the closer match.

vibration-pad.compare_note: Arctic specifies Airtech 18x18x3/8. Material list states no size.
